verifications.claim: Artemis II astronauts splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Floating in the Pacific Ocean on Friday... waters off San Diego... April 10'; R2: 'splashed down in the Pacific Ocean, about 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego, April 10, 2026'; R3: 'off the coast of San Diego'; R4: 'Pacific Ocean off the coast near San Diego, April 10, 2026'; R5: 'Pacific Ocean... off the San Diego coast, April 10, 2026'; R6: 'Pacific Ocean off the coast of California'; R7: 'off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. ET'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact location (Pacific off San Diego, CA) and date (April 10, 2026).

verifications.claim: Artemis II crew returned to Earth following a 10-day mission around the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'April 1... Friday [April 10]'; R2: 'historic 10-day trip to the moon'; R3: '9 days, 1 hour and 31 minutes... lunar flyby'; R4: '10-day journey to the moon'; R5: 'ten day voyage'; R6: 'nearly 10-day journey'; R7: '10-day mission... around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe it as a ~10-day mission around the moon, with launch April 1 and return April 10.

verifications.claim: Recovery teams retrieved Artemis II crew via helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'hoisted them up for hovering helicopters to take them to the U.S.S. John P. Murtha'; R2: 'hoisted into waiting helicopters and flown to... USS John P. Murtha'; R3: 'fly them via helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha'; R5: 'Navy MH-60 Seahawk... on the flight deck of USS John P. Murtha'; R7: 'hoisted into a helicopter... USS John P. Murtha'
verifications.reasoning: Direct descriptions of helicopter retrieval to the specific ship in multiple sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed moon mission since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first people to leave low-Earth orbit since 1972... first humans toward the Moon since 1972'; R3: 'first humans toward the Moon since 1972'; R5: 'first lunar voyage in more than half a century [Apollo 17=1972]'; R6: 'first time in more than 50 years'; R7: 'first humans in over 50 years to venture to the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it as the first crewed mission to the moon/LEO departure since 1972 (Apollo 17).

verifications.claim: Recovery vessel for Artemis II is USS John P. Murtha.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'U.S.S. John P. Murtha'; R2: 'USS John P. Murtha'; R3: 'USS John P. Murtha'; R5: 'USS John P. Murtha'; R7: 'USS John P. Murtha recovery vessel'
verifications.reasoning: Consistently identified as the recovery vessel across sources.

verifications.claim: Artemis II splashdown time is April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Exact date, time, and time zones match directly, especially R3.
